summary: Black Hawk Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq under BKHAU/BKHA/BKHAR, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing a $150,000 deposit into its trust account to extend its initial business combination deadline by one month, from September 22, 2026 to October 22, 2026. No target, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation was disclosed. The extension preserves the SPAC's deal clock and trust funds; investors should watch for a definitive combination agreement, additional extension payments, and the risk of liquidation or redemptions if no deal is reached.
